items.title: Producing a smooth chart through a versal finite-type family
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The deformation category satisfies (S1), (S2) by the (RS)-to-deformation-category transfer and has finite-dimensional tangent space by axiom [3], so the existence theorem produces a versal formal object xi; effectiveness makes it come from x over a finite-type U approximating xi by lemma-approximate-versal; openness of versality shrinks U so x is versal at all finite type points; then lemma-versal-smooth gives the (equation-smooth) property and lemma-implies-smooth concludes that (Sch/U) -> X is smooth.
